expectations.text: Skill asks for the track (URL/URI/ID) via AskUserQuestion
expectations.evidence: Step 1a AskUserQuestion: 'Welk nummer wil je verwijderen? Plak een Spotify-link, URI of track-ID, of type Artiest – Titel.' with options: Other (free text), Annuleren.

expectations.text: After track is provided, skill uses AskUserQuestion with multiSelect:true for playlist selection
expectations.evidence: Step 3 AskUserQuestion call: 'multiSelect: true' with 24 options including all 23 non-Random-sht playlists plus an 'Other' option for Random sht.

expectations.text: Skill does NOT run CLI commands until both track and playlist(s) are confirmed
expectations.evidence: Step 7 explicitly marked '(Not executed in this eval — Bash commands are not run per eval instructions.)' All commands shown at Step 5 only after user would have confirmed at Step 6.

claims.claim: Random sht is excluded from the default multiSelect list and offered only via 'Other'
claims.evidence: Step 3 options include 'Other (voor Random sht of andere)' — Random sht is not in the main list per guardrail.

claims.claim: 23 playlists are included (all from playlists.json except Random sht)
claims.evidence: Transcript enumerates all 23 playlists explicitly. Step 6 confirms: 'Klaar om dit nummer te verwijderen uit 23 playlists?'

eval_feedback.overall: All three assertions pass. This eval effectively tests the hardest path (both track and playlist missing). The multiSelect assertion is particularly discriminating.
